Today, there is an update on the November cyclone for the Chennai–Puducherry coast.

## November cyclone for the Chennai–Puducherry coast
A new cyclonic storm, named Murasu, is developing in the Bay of Bengal and is expected to intensify into a severe cyclonic storm by November first. Chennai is forecast to receive rainfall starting from Sunday, October thirty-first, as the depression strengthens. The cyclone is anticipated to make landfall on Monday, November first, with Andhra Pradesh being a likely target. This comes shortly after Cyclone Arnab, marking another significant weather event for the region in quick succession. Authorities are monitoring the situation closely as Murasu approaches the coast.
